name: Unbound guarantees Soul Bolt crits and adds crit damage below 20% health (#3096)
contract: Spell 706785 (Unbound) carries two OVERRIDE_CLASS_SCRIPTS auras on Soul Bolt (500627, family 36,
classmask 8388608): a guaranteed-crit selector and a +25% crit damage selector, both gated on the
Before the fix neither raw selector (20000/20001) is remapped by AscensionConditionalCombatRules, so
Unit::GetAscensionConditionalCombatModifier falls through its default case and both effects are inert.
After the fix, spell_taken_crit_chance for Soul Bolt against a sub-20%-health target reads 100, and
spell_critical_damage for Soul Bolt against that target is 25 points higher than against a full-health target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and scaling settle
SETUP: victim starts at full health
Above 20% health, Soul Bolt is not a guaranteed crit
Soul Bolt critical damage against a full-health victim
SETUP: victim is now below 20% health
Below 20% health, Soul Bolt is a guaranteed crit
Below 20% health, Soul Bolt's critical damage carries Unbound's +25%
Unlearning Unbound removes the guaranteed crit even below 20% health
Unlearning Unbound removes the crit damage bonus
